title: Calcutta High Court Extends Interim Protection To Abhishek Banerjee In DJ Remark Case, Declines Urgent Plea To Fly Abroad For Eye Treatment
description: The Calcutta High Court on Monday extended the interim protection granted to Trinamool Congress National General Secretary and Diamond Harbour MP Abhishek Banerjee from coercive action in connection with the criminal proceedings arising out of his alleged "DJ" remark.
